results.justification: Same root cause: the five @cfunc-wrapped UDAF callbacks in examples/irr.py have no try/except, so a raise inside an impl (e.g. NRT MemoryError during vector_push/vector_extend while a borrow_structref-borrowed state is live) is swallowed at numba's cfunc boundary, leaking the borrow incref and returning a silent zero/void default to DuckDB. Current EX-irr-MEM-1 (examples/irr.py:156) and the current review's own XC-numbox-MEM-1 (examples/irr.py:165) both report exactly this defect and cite the same numba cfunc-swallow contract. The @cres->@proxy migration only touched ducklib.py; the examples/irr.py UDAF callback pattern is unchanged, so the defect survives and is fully covered.
